description: Owner's React, TypeScript and Tailwind defaults: tokens, icon wrapper, layering, component folders, motion tokens, no suppressions, tooling

evals.prompt: Add a ConfirmDeleteProject dialog to our React + TypeScript + Tailwind app. It confirms deleting a project, has a trash icon, and the project is built from a shared ui/ folder with a Button primitive and an Icon component. There is no AGENTS.md. List the files you create and show the code.
assertions: Creates a PascalCase component folder containing the component, a variants file, a stories file, a test file and an index.ts
Uses an alert dialog (role alertdialog or an AlertDialog primitive) because the action is irreversible, not a plain dialog or window.confirm
The confirm button label names the verb and the object (for example Delete project), and no button is labelled Yes, OK or Continue
Imports the trash icon through the project's Icon component and never imports the icon package directly in the dialog
Uses only semantic token classes for color and spacing: no hex, rgb, oklch, palette-step class such as red-500, and no arbitrary pixel value
The story sets an accessibility check to fail on violations (a11y test: error or an axe run in the test) and has a play function that asserts an outcome
Uses named exports, a typed props interface and type=button on buttons, with no default export and no eslint-disable or ts-ignore comment
Mentions or sets the danger or destructive role for the confirm action so it looks different from the cancel action

evals.prompt: Our Tailwind app has no animations yet. Add a press effect to Button, a hover highlight on table rows, and an entrance and exit for toast notifications. Give me the CSS and component changes.
assertions: Defines duration and easing as named tokens (CSS custom properties or theme entries) and uses them, with no literal millisecond value or raw cubic-bezier inside component code
Uses a press scale of about 0.97 on :active
Never uses transition: all and names the transitioned properties
Gates the hover effect behind (hover: hover) and (pointer: fine), or declines hover motion for the dense table rows with a stated reason
The toast enters from about 0.95 scale or a percentage translate with opacity zero, never from scale(0), and the exit is shorter than the entrance
Keeps every routine duration at or under 300ms and uses no ease-in curve
Under prefers-reduced-motion removes transform and distance but keeps opacity or color transitions, rather than disabling every transition
Animates only transform and opacity for the toast and press effect

evals.prompt: Set up linting and formatting for a new bun-based React + Vite + TypeScript + Tailwind frontend in a monorepo folder frontend/. Layers are routes, features, entities, ui and lib. We use Phosphor icons. Give me the config files and the scripts.
assertions: Enforces the import direction routes, features, entities, ui, lib with dependency-cruiser or eslint-plugin-boundaries, with a default of disallow and no cycles
Bans direct imports of the icon package outside the Icon wrapper with a no-restricted-imports rule or a depcruise rule
Adds a lint rule against raw color values (hex, rgb, oklch) in className and style
Prettier config sets semi true, singleQuote true, trailingComma all, printWidth 100 and the Tailwind plugin with the functions cn, cx and tv
Uses bun commands (bun install --frozen-lockfile, bun run) and no npm, yarn or pnpm commands
Contains no eslint-disable comment and no ts-ignore, and does not set rules to off to get a pass
tsconfig enables strict, noUncheckedIndexedAccess and verbatimModuleSyntax, and a typecheck script uses tsc -b when project references are used
Defines one check script that chains typecheck, lint, format check, boundaries, build and test

evals.prompt: Review this dashboard screen and tell me whether it looks templated. Code: a hero h1 with className="bg-gradient-to-r from-violet-500 to-blue-500 bg-clip-text text-transparent"; above it a small uppercase tracked span reading 01 / OVERVIEW; then three identical rounded-2xl shadow-lg hover:scale-105 cards each with a lucide icon in a tinted circle, a heading and a line of text; a KPI row of tiles each with a big number, a green +12% pill and a sparkline; a button with style={{transition: 'all 0.5s ease-in'}}; a footer chip that always says All systems healthy. The project has a DESIGN.md with semantic tokens, flat surfaces and a Phosphor Icon wrapper.
assertions: Flags the gradient text and gives the reason (contrast depends on the gradient stop, emphasis should come from weight or size)
Flags transition: all and ease-in with the specific fix: named properties and an ease-out token, and a duration within the 300ms ceiling
Flags the lucide icon as a second icon set and says to use the project's Icon wrapper
Says the decorative eyebrow and 01 numbering carry no information, while noting an eyebrow is acceptable when it states a state or a risk
Flags the permanent healthy status chip because a healthy default should stay silent
Recommends setting KPIs as type without icon circles, pills or sparklines, and says color belongs on data
Treats the project's DESIGN.md tokens as the authority and does not impose one outside aesthetic such as editorial serif or glassmorphism
Frames each finding with why it reads as templated, and does not say a tell is banned unconditionally
